meta.note: These are NOT options. They are listed because they are widely recommended online, and because the penalty for choosing one is a percentage of the whole amount — which makes them the most expensive options on the page by a wide margin.

routes.name: Underground banks / 地下钱庄
routes.how_it_is_pitched: A 'finance company' takes RMB in China and has an associate release USD to your US account. No money ever crosses the border.
routes.why_illegal: This is the textbook 变相买卖外汇 (disguised FX trading) caught by FX Regulations Art.45 — warning, confiscation, up to 30% of the amount, 30%-100% if serious, and criminal liability where it constitutes a crime. It also typically involves unlicensed operation of a financial business.
routes.cn_penalty: Up to 30% of the amount; 30%-100% if serious; criminal referral
routes.us_risk: Currency-transaction reporting exposure and money-laundering risk; counterparty funds are frequently connected to fraud, so the receiving US bank may freeze or close the account

routes.name: Structuring across relatives' USD 50,000 quotas / 蚂蚁搬家
routes.how_it_is_pitched: Ask five relatives to each buy USD 50,000 and remit it to you.
routes.why_illegal: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art.62 prohibits using split transactions (分拆) to evade the facilitation quota and the authenticity review. Lending your quota gets you a risk warning letter, then a 'watch list' entry; borrowing someone else's quota puts you on the watch list directly. The watch-list period is the year of listing plus the following two years, during which every FX transaction needs full documentary review.
routes.cn_penalty: Risk warning; watch-list designation for the current year plus 2 more; full documentary review of every subsequent transaction; underlying conduct can also be penalised under the FX Regulations
routes.us_risk: If the money then comes to you as a 'gift', Form 3520 exposure arises; and deliberate structuring of currency transactions is separately prohibited under US law
routes.verdict: NEVER. This is the single most commonly recommended 'solution' online and it is expressly the conduct the rule targets.

routes.name: False purpose declaration / fabricated documents
routes.how_it_is_pitched: Declare the purchase as 'travel' or 'study' when it is really capital.
routes.why_illegal: 骗购外汇 is 非法套汇 under FX Regulations Art.40 — re-exchange ordered, up to 30% of the amount, 30%-100% if serious, criminal liability where applicable. PBoC Announcement [2004] No.16 Art.13 invokes exactly this article for false documents in a property-transfer application.
routes.cn_penalty: Up to 30%; 30%-100% if serious; criminal referral
routes.us_risk: A false statement on a bank form is a false statement; it also poisons every later filing that repeats it

routes.name: Buying goods or property abroad with the purchase quota
routes.how_it_is_pitched: Use the annual allowance to buy overseas property or securities.
routes.why_illegal: Overseas property purchase, securities investment and life/return-of-premium insurance are unopened capital-account items. Note the nuance for this user: a US citizen is 境外个人 and does not complete the Individual FX Purchase Application at all — so the more precise statement is that these purposes are simply not open on the capital account, and dressing a capital transfer as a current-account item is P03.
routes.us_risk: None specific; US tax rules for foreign property apply
routes.verdict: Not available. The capital account is not open for these purposes.

routes.name: Crypto / stablecoin as a conversion bridge
routes.how_it_is_pitched: Buy USDT with RMB on an OTC desk, transfer it, sell for USD.
routes.why_illegal: The operative rule is now 银发〔2026〕42号 (effective 2026-02-06), which REPEALED the 2021 '924 notice'. It keeps virtual-currency business activity as an illegal financial activity, bars financial institutions and payment institutions from providing account, transfer, clearing or settlement services for it, and provides that individuals' virtual-currency investment acts that offend public order are VOID with losses borne by the investor. Anyone still citing 银发〔2021〕237号 as current law is quoting a repealed document.
routes.cn_penalty: Civil acts void; illegal-financial-activity enforcement against the counterparty, which is what usually destroys the individual's money; 变相买卖外汇 exposure under FX Regulations Art.45
routes.us_risk: Full US tax treatment of digital assets; counterparty and sanctions risk; the Chinese-side desk is unlicensed
routes.verdict: NEVER. And note the two-layer trap: the rule most of the internet cites for this was itself repealed in February 2026.

routes.name: Borrowing or lending a bank card for overseas cash withdrawal
routes.how_it_is_pitched: Use a friend's card once you hit your RMB 100,000 annual ATM cap.
routes.why_illegal: 汇发〔2017〕29号 Art.1 expressly prohibits both borrowing another person's card and lending your own to evade the overseas cash-withdrawal limits.
routes.cn_penalty: Suspension of overseas cash access for the current and following year; FX Regulations penalties depending on severity
routes.us_risk: Possible account takeover / AML flags on the receiving side
